goal: Harvest all remaining page272 local structural/semantic/review/head evidence from one trustworthy rendered target payload plus one matching reference payload, while explicitly preserving native validation semantics and avoiding false review-content PASS from lossy normalization.
trust_gate: browser branch uses at most one source + one target tab and opens no replacement loop
if any identity mismatch/disconnect occurs, stop the browser branch and record no PASS

normalization_allowed: convert non-breaking whitespace characters to ordinary spaces for comparison
collapse runs of layout whitespace to one space
text_capture_contract.rule: A mismatch in meaningful characters/tokens remains a mismatch even if visual wrapping differs. Keep raw text evidence so normalization can be audited.

Otolecz Transzportbeton Kft. Otolecz Andrea · ügyvezető

for_each_pair: tab DOM id, raw visible text, computed accessible name, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-controls, aria-selected, tabindex
panel DOM id, aria-labelledby, role, hidden/display/inert state and source-order index
raw + normalized full visible quote text
image naturalWidth/naturalHeight and rendered width/height when available
image alt and computed accessible name
pair_checks: each tab aria-controls resolves to exactly its panel
each panel aria-labelledby resolves to exactly its tab
no quote/author/image content accidentally duplicated between panels
current target compared against trustworthy reference before any content correction
review_capture.write_rule: A content/media mismatch is diagnostic only here. It becomes its own smallest-owner package and is never folded into semantic ID36.

form_idle_capture.relation_resolution: Resolve every IDREF token to its actual element and capture the referenced raw text; unresolved or duplicate IDs fail the semantic gate.

form_safe_validation_capture_if_availabl.network_policy: No real form submission, entry creation, SMTP or external request. Only a client-side/native validation trigger that can be proven not to send data is eligible.
capture_after_trigger: same form/service/city ARIA attributes as idle
all validation/error nodes added under Form33 with IDs/roles/text
whether each added IDREF resolves exactly once
whether project-owned descriptor IDs remain alongside native error/help IDs rather than replacing them
form_safe_validation_capture_if_availabl.if_no_safe_trigger: Do not improvise a submission. Leave dynamic validation-state proof open and retain the v005 preservation design plus live idle conflict gate.

other_exact_capture.headings: Ordered main-content array of {level, rawText, normalizedText, stable owner/ancestor}; exclude global header/footer headings from page-local tree but record them separately if encountered.
other_exact_capture.proof_carousel: Container role; direct item count; emitted item roles; parent roles; names; active marker; owner classes/data; do not authorize role rewrite until source is re-observed in same trustworthy pair.
other_exact_capture.hero: Hero art ancestry plus ordered hero-copy heading/paragraph/CTA descendants for each candidate common ancestor.
other_exact_capture.gallery: Exact Sövénymunkák heading node ancestry plus b2e2c001 ancestry.
other_exact_capture.form_outer: af2e004c ancestry plus Form33 wrapper ancestry; candidate root must contain complete source-equivalent intro+form and must not swallow unrelated neighboring sections.
other_exact_capture.document_head: title; meta description; canonical count/href; robots; og:title/og:description/og:url; JSON-LD script count, parser-validity, top-level @type/@graph types and owner clues. D09 /slug/ route adaptation is allowed.

v005_deployment_gate_from_same_payload: review root count=1, tablist count=1, tab count=3 and expected source order
current review aria naming state is conflict-free with exact label contract
all current native IDREF tokens resolve and no unexpected semantic owner requires HOLD
any unresolved native semantic ambiguity => HOLD rather than write
browser_memory_rule: Exactly one source + one target project tab maximum; zero replacement/reconnect loops. Stop on stale, repurposed or disconnected state.
call_budget_effect: No extra target WPVibe call versus v002 when all target evidence comes from the already-planned broad rendered payload; optional safe client-side validation capture is browser-side and must not create an entry/network submission.
